title: Text field editing: Static/Dynamic/Input text on stage
description: The Text tool (T) exists in the toolbar but text cannot be edited after placement. Implement the full text field lifecycle: (1) Text tool click creates a TextDisplayObject at the click position with a default string; (2) Double-click enters edit mode with an inline contenteditable or <textarea> overlay; (3) Properties panel shows font/size/color/style/alignment controls for the selected text object; (4) SWF compiler emits DefineText2 (static) or DefineEditText (dynamic/input). See docs/06-text-typography.md.
